bands: Pan about 0.35 m, 8-band MS about 1.4 m
acquisition: One satellite pass. Vantor's catalog and CSDA give a pass different IDs, so records of the same sensor within 120 seconds are matched and count once.
footprint: One strip per pass in Vantor's catalog. CSDA delivers products cut to the order.
cloud: For the whole strip, so a cloudy strip can still be clear over a small site.
scope: Vantor's catalog shows everything collected; set Source to In CSDA to see what has been delivered. Vantor's catalog does not list levels, so levels are shown for CSDA products only.
